tooltip.endlesssands.tiny_oldworld_jar.t: Potted plants were used as hasty storage containers when the sand began to consume their homes. Against the curse these crates grew brittle.
Dear diary, Susie looked at me today… I blushed.
tooltip.endlesssands.scroll_of_wisdom_th: , flowers that wilted away as their iron rusted in the sand.
screen.endlesssands.buried.title: Buried in the Sand
message.endlesssands.heatstroke.tier_i: I'm not dressed for this desert
message.endlesssands.heatstroke.tier_ii: I need at least three pieces of desert gear
message.endlesssands.heatstroke.tier_iii: I need at least two pieces of desert gear
message.endlesssands.heatstroke.tier_iv: If I don't find some shade I'll surely die
advancements.endlesssands.cant_beat_the_:
Heatstroke, if not treated will lead to death:
Cause: Being out in the sun for over a minute without a full set of sun gear
Effect: Mining Fatigue I
Cure: Get yourself a full set of sun gear... the not implemented yet don't seem to have too much trouble
advancements.endlesssands.scorched_earth:
Guess this is the fate that awaits all Oldworld creatures
Cause: Being out in the sun for over 10 minutes without any shade
Effect: Mining Fatigue I, Slowness I, Hunger I, & a slow, painful death
Cure: Get some shade, SPF, or equip yourself a twig hat
advancements.endlesssands.the_sun_is_a_d: The sun is a deadly laser

They say heatstroke is one of the worst ways to go out
Cause: Being out in the sun for over 5 minutes without at least 2 pieces of sun gear on
Effect: Mining Fatigue I, Slowness I, & Hunger I
Cure: Get yourself just 2 pieces of sun gear... not implemented yet
advancements.endlesssands.too_hot_to_han:
The longer you're in the sun, the worse the effect becomes
Cause: Being out in the sun for over 3 minutes without at least 3 pieces of sun gear on
Effect: Mining Fatigue I & Slowness I
Cure: Get yourself at least 3 pieces of sun gear... try out some not implemented yet
advancements.endlesssands.find_a_vulture:
Chickens... or maybe parrots... evolved into these scavengers of the desert
Locate a vulture... maybe consider following it
advancements.endlesssands.what_a_cruddy_:
The sun's heat bearing down has turned this tree into practically charcoal
Locate a crud tree
I wonder how the vultures would react to their nest being destroyed/stolen?
advancements.endlesssands.what_goes_up_m: What goes up mustn't come down

Seems some of the land managed to escape the Pharaoh's grasp
Locate a floating island
These twigs seem mighty useful. Alas, only half as useful as the stuff we could find up there
advancements.endlesssands.craft_yourself: Craft a twig hat or twig visor
advancements.endlesssands.guard_up.title: Guard up
advancements.endlesssands.guard_up.descr: Vulture leather and twigs should be enough to get the job done
advancements.endlesssands.new_best_frien: Tame yourself a loyal avian companion... just make sure you've got the proper gear to do so first
advancements.endlesssands.the_ruins_of_t: Your loyal avian friend can lead you there... just don't get your hopes up on what you will find.
advancements.endlesssands.a_far_off_voic: A distant presence reaches across realms.
advancements.endlesssands.collect_fragme: Collect an Elder Eye, Nether Star, and Dragon Egg.
